mistake_reason: After receiving the complete slide texts (including Slide 7: "Spider crab"), PowerPoint_Expert withheld the presence of Slide 7 when summarizing candidates, stating they would avoid redundancy in multiple crab references. This concealed a critical data point that should have been communicated to downstream agents. The Information Withholding (FM-2.4) caused BiologicalTaxonomy_Expert and Verification_Expert to count only Slides 2, 4, and 6, producing the wrong answer of 3 instead of the correct 4.
